$comment: Golden recording of the legacy PHP system's READ endpoints. See test/contract/README.md. Body fixtures are stored byte-exact, with no trailing newline.

notes.closed: Recorded verbatim from the live endpoint; the space was closed at the time.
notes.open: Derived, not recorded: the space was closed for the whole recording window. SpaceApiScripts/index.php builds the document from hard-coded values plus one dynamic input (the `state` field of spacestate.php), and sets both `open` and `state.open` to the same boolean, so the open document is the recorded one with `"open":false` -> `"open":true` in both places and nothing else changed.

spaceapi.serverHeadersOmitted: The live host adds Apache/Pixelbar headers (server, x-frame-options, content-security-policy, x-content-type-options, referrer-policy, x-xss-protection, host) that belong to the old web server, not to the endpoint's contract. They are deliberately not part of this recording.

notes.closed: Recorded verbatim from the live endpoint; the space was closed at the time.
notes.open: Derived, not recorded: the space was closed for the whole recording window. spacestate.php emits `json_encode(array("state" => <state>), JSON_NUMERIC_CHECK)` with the state column verbatim, and the `state` column only ever holds `open` or `closed` (togglestate.php writes nothing else), so the open body is `{"state":"open"}`.

spacestate.alsoServedAt: https://spacestate.pixelbar.nl/state/ — SpaceStateScripts/state/index.php is a byte-for-byte copy of spacestate.php. The rewrite does not serve it; see test/contract/README.md.

togglestate.notRecorded: Never called: it is a write endpoint and a request would change the real space status. Its contract below is read off SpaceStateScripts/togglestate.php and togglebaker.php.
togglestate.headerNotes: The PHP sets no Content-Type, Cache-Control or CORS header on any toggle outcome, so the body goes out under PHP's default_mimetype (`text/html; charset=UTF-8`) and with no CORS. `header('Location: ...')` with no status argument is a 302.
